retained_files.transformation: Recompiled from the release paper source after refreshing author metadata.

excluded: legacy chat agents, Gym entrypoints, memory/vector databases and rule bots
SMAC old training stacks and unused PySC2 converters/test fixtures
raw experiment events/replays/videos and host diagnostics
old paper drafts, duplicate figures, archives and build products
local_archive_policy: Original working trees and original chronological experiment data remain in the research workspace. They are not deleted or rewritten by this release preparation.
packaging_changes: macro package initialization no longer registers unused Gym environments
unused Protoss process launch helpers and their legacy config imports removed
35 registered SMAC maps consolidated into one directory
Refreshed the paper source with concurrent author metadata edits before compiling the release PDF
Public text files use LF line endings; source hashes describe the originally imported files.
Macro replay decoder default uses DISTAR_ROOT or external/di-star instead of a workstation-specific directory.
Derived paper snapshot paths are relative; original chronological experiment logs are not rewritten.
Removed redundant final blank lines and trailing whitespace outside multiline strings; every changed Python file retained an identical AST during this formatting pass.
Also cleaned whitespace in one upstream non-executing comment string (identical compiled Python code) and the TeX style, preserving license notices.
